sentence: This project studies the gene regulatory mechanisms behind coronary artery disease and related vascular disease.
This project uses human 3D neuro-muscular assembloids to study which cells enteroviruses infect and which host factors they use.
This project studies how red blood cell breakdown and transfusion practices contribute to organ injury in children receiving extracorporeal membrane oxygenation.
This project builds a library of research reagents and standardized assays to speed up work on a virus vaccine.
This project uses AI to find drugs that renew damaged mucus-secreting goblet cells in ulcerative colitis.
This project holds a conference that shares advances in immunology, bioengineering and computational sciences.
This project studies how an RNA and a protein interact in human immunodeficiency virus 1 and builds a model of what that does in cells.
This project explores how speckle structured illumination can image the cornea with better resolution and a wider field of view.
This project offers cancer researchers sequencing of DNA and RNA, single cell genomics, spatial transcriptomics and data analysis.
This project tries to find the mixed cell populations that drive cancer stem cell self-renewal and metastasis in pediatric rhabdomyosarcoma muscle cancer.
This project studies the genetic and developmental basis of sex-limited polymorphism in a mimetic butterfly.
This project offers cancer researchers hybridomas, monoclonal antibodies, recombinant proteins, organoid services and live-cell imaging.
This project studies how the complement system gets activated and adds to organ failure and delayed deaths after traumatic injury.
This project studies what controls a Hippo pathway regulator that helps cause podocyte injury and tests treatments for it.
This project builds imaging biomarkers using Magnetic Resonance Fingerprinting and artificial intelligence to detect clinically significant prostate cancer without unnecessary procedures.
This project tests whether the makeup and function of gut bacteria can predict acute cellular rejection after liver transplant.
This project provides pathology and genomic analysis of lung cancer samples, including sequencing of tumor DNA and imaging of immune cells.
This project studies how neural activity across connected brain areas tracks internal variables while macaques forage.
This project studies why an overdose of the fusion oncoprotein that drives Ewing sarcoma is toxic to the tumor cells.
This project studies how sub-epithelial cells next to the intestinal epithelium support intestinal stem cells, using cultures grown from stem cells.
